title: Chachapoyas sites of the Utcubamba Valley
authors: Peru, UNESCO World Heritage tentative-list submission
lineage: Passages inspected; retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: Kuelap Archaeological Complex and comparative analysis
passages.note: The nomination describes Kuelap’s enclosure and Chachapoyas buildings with possible defensive and slope-stabilizing functions. It dates most visible site buildings broadly to 900–1470 CE, not the construction of any particular wall.
